_comment: Skip trace vendor. DISABLED until you fill this in, and billable once you do.
This is the only per record cost in the system, and it is the one thing free
public records genuinely cannot give you. County data hands you an owner name
and a mailing address, which is everything you need for direct mail. It does
not hand you a phone number.
PRICING SEEN IN PUBLIC SOURCES, verify against your own quote:
pay as you go, roughly 0.07 to 0.18 per record depending on vendor
some vendors quote per match rather than per attempt, which is cheaper
avoid anything with a four figure monthly minimum, it blows the budget alone
Set costPerRecordCents from YOUR quote. Every budget check uses it, so a wrong
number here means a wrong ceiling. 10 means ten cents per record.
NO VENDOR SCHEMA IS HARDCODED. requestTemplate is filled per lead from these
placeholders, and the response is scanned for anything resembling a phone or
an email, so the vendor's field names do not matter:
{{firstName}} {{lastName}} {{fullName}} {{companyName}}
{{address}} {{city}} {{state}} {{zip}}                  owner mailing address
{{propertyAddress}} {{propertyCity}} {{propertyState}} {{propertyZip}}
The mailing address is used as the trace input rather than the property
address, because for an absentee owner the mailing address is where they live.
Put the key in .env under the name given by apiKeyEnv. Never in this file.
